notes: Rolling 30-day query and separate five-calendar-day query merged by stable video ID; older records and prior observations preserved. Metrics are cumulative at observation; not daily view gains. No creative attribution without verified linked sources.

data_quality.completion_rate: TKPO13 raw values retained; scale not validated, do not convert to percentages.
data_quality.average_watch_time: TKPO15 described as seconds; rounded values; do not infer precise retention.
data_quality.published_time: TKPO02 has no verified timezone. Per-day counts use Metricool source date, not confirmed local posting date.
data_quality.reach: 9 returned posts have positive views and zero reach; treat reach as unreliable for these.
data_quality.sales: TikTok Shop sales, clicks, GMV not connected; unavailable, not zero.
data_quality.creative_mapping: No verified original Gemini generation ID-to-published TikTok URL mapping; do not infer product or camera angle from metrics.
data_quality.freshness: Latest Metricool source published date 20261028; no 2026-10-29 video rows returned as of morning check. Missing rows are not evidence of no posts.
